public_rationale: Microsoft reported a large AI revenue run rate, and reporting on Midjourney supplies material counterevidence to the broad rhetoric. Neither record establishes comparable target-quarter generative-AI profit. The revenue threshold and profit accounting basis are unspecified, so the combined claim cannot fairly receive a firm verdict.
limitations: Unknown accounting basis prevents a supported or contradicted money verdict.
A revenue run rate is not realized annual or quarterly revenue.
Missing profit disclosures do not establish losses.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: It sure seems like nobody outside of OpenAI is making any real revenue on generative AI, and those outside OpenAI are certainly not making a profit.

statement.excerpt: It sure seems like nobody outside of OpenAI is making any real revenue on generative AI, and they're certainly not making a profit.

from_speaker: any real revenue on generative AI
our_interpretation: The revenue limb means commercially substantial sales, not literally zero revenue. The context itself acknowledges Microsoft and Amazon sales.
The firm profitability limb means positive profit from generative AI after attributable costs, rather than positive revenue, gross margin or profit from an entire cloud division.

I use October–December 2024 as the latest completed common reporting quarter underlying the company figures discussed in the post. This does not imply every company's latest available disclosure covered that quarter.

The single metric_scope describes the categorical profit assertion. Its accounting basis is unknown because neither an accounting standard nor a company-reported generative-AI profit measure is specified.
The revenue limb has no supplied materiality threshold. I do not invent one.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable evidence establishes that companies outside OpenAI had no positive generative-AI profit in the target period, and that their generative-AI sales were commercially insubstantial under an identifiable materiality measure.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A company outside OpenAI demonstrably earned positive generative-AI profit on the same accounting basis in the target period, or comparable realized sales clearly refute an established reading of commercially insubstantial revenue.
